supply_token.name: Supply Token
supply_token.lore: A ration stamp. The Supply Exchange in the market takes it.

hearth_key.name: Hearth Key
hearth_key.lore: Opens the oak doors of the Hearthwarden Hall.

onDone.text: A bell rings once. Somewhere, a pantry hatch lifts.

waves.say: The dummies start to move. They have wooden swords.

onDone.text: The yard falls quiet. A Supply Token lies on the plate.

onOpen.text: The stallholder's ghost nods and the bar to the millrace swings up.

mechanics.hint: A stall counter with a slot for a ration token.
mechanics.verb: slides the Supply Token across the counter.

onDone.text: The posts all point home. A cellar hatch opens in the south of the commons.

mechanics.failText: Wrong turning. The road runs east, north, west, south.

onOpen.text: The great oak doors of the Hearthwarden Hall open.

mechanics.hint: Great oak doors, banded with iron and a big keyhole.
mechanics.verb: turns the Hearth Key and the great oak doors swing open.

encounters.say: Awnings flap in no wind. The market still thinks it is open.
A fire burns in the commons with no one to tend it. Four signposts stand at the compass points: the road runs east, north, west, south.

bosses.name: The Hearthwarden
bosses.intro: The Hearthwarden rises from the high seat. Douse the three hearth-stones on the posts to put out its fire.
bosses.deathText: The Hearthwarden sets down its axe, and the fire dies to embers.

shield.breakText: The hearth-stones go cold! The Hearthwarden is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Hearthwarden calls its servants.

effects.text: Embers fly from the long hearth.

completion.intro: The Hearthwarden Village. Win a ration token in the yard, and the market will let you through.
completion.message: The fires burn low. The village closes shortly.
